meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可管理作者习惯、启动本地 Dashboard。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「记住我的写作习惯」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 说清想写的小说,自动找到对应工具并记住你的写作习惯
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想写网络小说却不知从哪个工具入手,或想留存自己的写作偏好
copy.tagline_en: Describe your novel idea and it finds the right tool and remembers your habits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to write web novels but aren't sure which tool to start with

howto.what: 装上后它作为网文工具箱入口：你说出写作需求，它自动分发到对应的子技能（长篇/短篇写作、拆文、扫榜、审稿、封面等），还能记住你的写作习惯、启动本地工作台、检查更新。
howto.when: 当你说 /story、/网文 或「我想写小说」等触发词时接管；请求模糊时它给出四个白话选项让你选，还没部署过则先建议 /story-setup。

say.text: 我想写一部长篇，先帮我规划剧情和大纲
say.note: 会路由到长篇写作技能

say.text: 帮我把这一章去一下 AI 味
say.note: 会路由到去 AI 味技能
启动本地 Dashboard 并返回本机地址

howto.what_en: It is the entry point of a web-novel toolbox: you say what you want and it routes to the matching sub-skill (long/short writing, analysis, review, cover, etc.). It can also store your writing habits and launch a local dashboard.
howto.when_en: It takes over on /story, /网文 or phrases like "I want to write a novel". With a vague request it offers four plain options; if nothing is deployed it suggests /story-setup first.

say_en.text: I want to write a long novel, help me plan the plot and outline
say_en.note: Routes to the long-form writing skill

say_en.text: Take the AI flavor out of this chapter

say_en.note: Starts the local dashboard and returns its URL
